packet_dag.terminal_condition: REQ-20260710-020 reaches Done only after the CRM workbench is committed, pushed, deployed, live-smoked, and screenshot-reviewed, or has a precise blocker.

title: One Time CRM Searchable List Detail Timeline Workbench

reasons: The source says API counts and marker-only smokes are not completion proof.
The One Time provider CRM view must be searchable, filterable, sortable, and open into useful contact detail and timeline readback.
Current source inspection found an API-backed first-party CRM panel plus a separate One Time review table; this packet keeps the implementation surface bounded to the One Time CRM route.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time provider CRM contact workbench
likely_external_provider_blockers: No GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access, DNS, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, or provider-account write is approved in this packet.
Real follow-up sends remain blocked until REQ-20260710-022 has runtime readiness and exact operator approval.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Historical inbox/contact import reconciliation after the CRM workbench route is proven.

operator_intent_summary: Turn the One Time CRM route into a real first-party workbench where Rabbi/Shloimie can search/filter/sort scoped contacts, open a useful detail pane, read lifecycle/source/last-activity/contact context, see local timeline interactions, and understand safe next actions without triggering external writes.
raw_quotes: The CRM must become a real first-party workspace with searchable/filterable contacts, clickable contact detail, timeline, lifecycle/source, last activity, email/WhatsApp interactions, class/trial/access context, notes, and next actions.
API counts and marker-only smokes are not completion proof.
A submitted lead must be searchable and openable in a useful CRM contact profile/detail view.

decisions_captured.decision: Public WhatsApp runtime activation remains separate from the CRM readback workbench.
Direct GitHub issue readback is blocked by local gh token scope; use the materialized packet and raw intake for this slice.

out_of_scope: No live email, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, or bulk campaign send.
No payment, checkout, subscription, access grant, class link mutation, DNS, credential, Drive, Zoom, Vimeo, Buffer, or external provider mutation.
No GHL/LeadConnector runtime and no external CRM writes.
No historical 2,600-record import reconciliation in this packet.
No transactional free-class follow-up implementation beyond showing readiness/blocked next-action context.
affected_surfaces: Operations One Time Contacts > CRM Contacts
One Time provider contact detail/readback pane

observed_findings: The API-backed first-party CRM panel already supports search, type/status/source/tag filters, sort, and timeline readback.
The One Time provider CRM section currently renders a static review table/cards from local lead/member arrays and does not expose a selected detail/timeline workbench state.
The provider CRM audit reported the shell rendered without overflow or fixture/diagnostic leaks, but the audit status is FAIL and requires renewed visual proof after implementation.
The form-to-CRM E2E smoke proved a TEST lead can be created, found in parent-leads/CRM contact search, found in timeline, and archived.

expanded_phrases.real first-party workspace: The route renders an operational workbench with filters, list, selected detail, timeline, states, and safe next actions using first-party BNA data.
expanded_phrases.searchable/filterable contacts: Search, contact type, status, source, tag, and sort controls feed the scoped first-party CRM API and visibly update counts/results.
expanded_phrases.useful CRM contact profile/detail: Selecting a row/card opens identity, lifecycle/source, last activity, contact channels, class/trial/access context, notes, and next actions.
expanded_phrases.timeline: Timeline readback uses local BNA communication/lead records and clearly states read-only/no-send behavior.
expanded_phrases.launch-ready: This route can be shown to the operator/Rabbi without marker-only proof; final Done still requires deploy and live smoke.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: All CRM-like behavior is implemented as first-party BNA Operations readback over project-scoped local tables. GHL/LeadConnector/external CRM writes are forbidden.

requirements.expected_result: Contact rows support search/filter/sort and open a useful detail pane/route with overview, timeline, class/trial/access, notes, and next actions.

criteria: REQ-20260710-019 is deployed and live-smoked, proving first-party form-to-CRM data exists.
Current source inspection identified existing CRM API endpoints and the static One Time provider CRM panel.
The implementation scope is limited to the One Time CRM route/API readback/test proof.
External writes, sends, payments, and access changes are explicitly out of scope.

loading.expected_visible_message: Loading CRM contacts or a stable workbench shell appears without layout jump.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: The loading region remains inside the contacts section and controls keep accessible names.
loading.accessibility_expectation: No horizontal overflow or overlapping helper on desktop.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Local smoke can open the route and wait for either CRM results or a scoped empty state.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Open CRM route when no scoped contacts are returned.
empty.expected_visible_title: No One Time CRM contacts loaded yet
empty.expected_visible_message: The empty state explains approved sources and no-send guardrails.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty cards are grouped under the CRM section heading.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Mobile empty-state text wraps without clipping.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Static test keeps data-one-time-crm-empty-state and no-send copy.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Load CRM route after at least one One Time lead exists.
populated.expected_visible_message: List/table/card rows show identity, lifecycle/source, last activity, no-send, dedupe/review, and next action.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Each row/card is keyboard reachable and exposes selected state.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Table/card text wraps and actions do not collide.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: E2E smoke finds the TEST contact in CRM search before cleanup.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Apply a search or filter that returns zero rows.
filtered_empty.expected_visible_title: No contacts match this CRM filter
filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: The user can clear/change filters without losing scope.
filtered_empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Filtered count text changes and empty state is announced by visible text.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Mobile filter controls fit without clipped labels.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Filter smoke verifies a nonsense query returns a scoped empty state.

error.how_to_enter_state: Force CRM API readback failure or unauthorized API response.
error.expected_visible_message: A concise error banner explains that contacts could not load and offers Refresh.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error text is visible near the CRM controls.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Static source inspection confirms errors render through firstPartyCrmError or equivalent.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Open a send/follow-up affordance before REQ-20260710-022 approval/readiness.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Email/WhatsApp/payment/access follow-up is locked until explicit approval and runtime readiness.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Disabled or blocked actions include a visible reason.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Blocked-state copy is concise and not hidden only in hover text.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Tests assert no external write action is exposed as enabled in CRM workbench.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Open a product-interest/member row that is not editable as a parent lead.
preview_only.expected_visible_message: The row explains which source panel owns the record and why no external action runs.
preview_only.aria_semantic_expectation: Preview-only actions use disabled buttons or links with clear labels.
preview_only.accessibility_expectation: Preview cards are visually distinct from editable lead rows.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Static test finds preview-only/no-send member/product interest copy.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Submit a synthetic TEST/example.invalid lead, search it, open the contact, and read its timeline.
success_readback.expected_visible_message: The timeline shows the public signup capture note and no-send/read-only state.
success_readback.aria_semantic_expectation: Selected contact and timeline headings are visible after readback.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Timeline items remain readable and do not overflow.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Live E2E smoke verifies CRM lead id, contact search, timeline item, and archive cleanup.

permission_denied.how_to_enter_state: Request CRM contacts without CRM entitlement or with wrong workspace scope.
permission_denied.expected_visible_message: Access is denied or upgrade/permission text is shown without leaking contact data.
permission_denied.aria_semantic_expectation: Permission message is visible and not only a console error.
permission_denied.accessibility_expectation: The denied state is readable in desktop/tablet layout.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: Entitlement tests keep free provider denied for CRM contacts.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open a CRM contact card on mobile.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Selected overview/timeline/actions stack below the card without clipped controls.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: The selected card uses aria-expanded and the detail region has a heading.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Touch targets are at least 38px and long emails/phones wrap.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile Playwright smoke opens a card and verifies no horizontal overflow.

findings.user_impact: Rabbi/Shloimie cannot treat marker-only CRM cards as proof that the public form creates searchable, openable contact history.
findings.expected_fix: Replace or augment the static One Time review table with an API-backed searchable workbench, selected detail, and timeline readback.

required_checks: Search/filter/select controls have visible labels or accessible names.
Selected CRM row/card exposes aria-expanded or equivalent visible selected state.
Timeline region has a heading and readable contrast.
Mobile cards and actions remain reachable without horizontal scroll.
